zoe: Quick preflight for Tarnwell private/VPC dry-run tomorrow 07:30 PT. Need a short audit: peering routes, NAT capacity, CMK policy for audit role, and CloudTrail S3 sink + retention. Tagging @ali @samir :wave:

ali: On it. I'll verify VPC peering and route table parity for prod-app, analytics, and cache subnets.

samir: I'll check KMS and CloudTrail. Key items: CMK state, creation date, rotation, and whether cloudtrail.amazonaws.com is allowed. Also capture any existing grants.

ali: Found missing peer route in analytics-rtb to prod-cidr. Will add route and record change id. Command: `aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3 --destination-cidr-block 10.60.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0a9b8c7`

ops-bot: infra-bot: Route create chg-0b2c3d4 recorded at 2026-03-26T22:11:02Z by ali

samir: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999900001111:key/zz11yy22 created 2024-09-30. Policy missing CloudTrail principal and explicit redwood-audit role. Sample patch to add: `{"Sid":"AllowCloudTrail","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}`

ali: NATs: two NAT gateways (nat-0aa111, nat-0bb222). Analytics subnets were pointing at IGW by mistake; switched to NAT and queued smoke. Also flagged sg-0ff334 with 0.0.0.0/0 egress on app-tier ephemeral ports.

zoe: please post SG/NAT/route gist links so CS can attach to the support ticket. Also note renewal ask: customer requested HSM-backed keys + 7y retention. Marking renewal risk as "medium" until solutions provides cost delta.

ali: uploaded network snapshot: https://gist.github.com/redwood/tarnwell-net-snapshot (routes, rtb, NATs, SG export)

samir: KMS policy PR opened and rotation is ON. I'll add the CloudTrail principal and push policy JSON to the runbook. Also adding short migration steps to enable SSE-KMS on bucket and a one-off s3 cp job to re-encrypt existing objects.

zoe: great. I'll update the onboarding runbook, add the renewal risk to the customer health card, and send the draft to Tarnwell ops for sign-off. Dry-run 07:30 PT tomorrow. Closing this sync. :thumbsup:
